# MarkdownEditor — Live preview > A CodeMirror editor where the Markdown text is the document: markup shows only where the caret touches it. Status: beta. This file matches the installed `markdown-editor-live` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/markdown-editor-live.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/markdown-editor-live.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0` - `@codemirror/commands@6.11.1` - `@codemirror/lang-markdown@6.5.2` - `@codemirror/language@6.13.1` - `@codemirror/state@6.7.6` - `@codemirror/view@6.43.15` - `@lezer/common@1.5.6` - `@lezer/markdown@1.8.1` ## Registry dependencies - `checkbox` - `core` - `markdown-editor-parts` - `typography` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor-live`: `MarkdownEditor`, `MarkdownEditorContent`, types `MarkdownEditorContentProps`, `MarkdownEditorProps`, `MarkdownEditorStatus` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/drag/block-drag`: `blockDragging`, `createLiveBlocks` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/drag/block-model`: `blockAt`, `blockStartingAt`, `siblingBlocks`, `moveBlock`, `dropBlock`, types `MarkdownBlockUnit`, `BlockMove` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/format/blocks`: `activeBlocks`, `headingLevel`, `toggleBlock`, `setHeading`, `replaceWithBlock` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/format/inline`: `blockPrefix`, `enclosingNode`, `codeBlockAt`, `insideCode`, `isMarkActive`, `mapInward`, `toggleMark`, types `TextChange` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/format/keymap`: `editingKeymap`, `markdownMarkKeymap`, `markdownFormatKeymap` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/format/links`: `linkAt`, `setLink`, `imageMarkdown`, `insertImage`, `replaceWithMention` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/format/list-indent`: `indentListItem` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/live-engine`: `createLiveEditor`, types `LiveEditor` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/live-setup`: `liveSetup`, `reconfigureLive`, types `LiveSettings`, `LiveServices` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/preview/live-preview`: `markdownUrlPolicy`, `livePreview` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/preview/recipe-theme`: `recipeTheme` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/preview/task-checkboxes`: `LiveTaskCheckboxes` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/preview/widgets`: `TaskCheckboxes`, `taskCheckboxes`, `TaskWidget`, `BulletWidget`, `ImageWidget`, types `TaskCheckbox`, `TaskCheckboxEntry` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/table/cell-editor`: `CellEditor`, types `CellMove`, `CellEdit`, `CellHost` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/table/live-tables`: `activeTableCell`, `liveTables`, `createLiveTables` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/table/table-model`: `parseTable`, `cellAt`, `moveRow`, `moveColumn`, `insertRow`, `insertColumn`, `deleteRow`, `deleteColumn`, `alignColumn`, `appendRow`, `appendColumn`, `createTableMarkdown`, `escapeCellText`, types `TableAlign`, `TableCell`, `TableRow`, `MarkdownTableModel`, `TableEdit` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/table/table-widget`: `fromCell`, `renderedTables`, `tableViewOf`, `TableView`, `TableWidget`, types `TableLine`, `TableCellAddress` - `@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/live/upload-placeholders`: `clearPlaceholders`, `uploadPlaceholders`, `createLiveUploads` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { useState } from "react"; import { MarkdownEditorSuggestions } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/suggestions"; import { MarkdownEditorToolbar, MarkdownEditorUploads } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor/toolbar"; import { MarkdownEditor, MarkdownEditorContent } from "@/components/control-ui/markdown-editor-live"; import { Code, CodeContent } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/code"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; const people = [ { id: "alex", label: "Alex Morgan", href: "/people/alex", description: "Design" }, { id: "sam", label: "Sam Rivera", href: "/people/sam", description: "Engineering" }, { id: "jordan", label: "Jordan Lee", href: "/people/jordan", description: "Product" }, ]; const initialMarkdown = `## Project feedback We need **clearer feedback** on the new dashboard. - [x] Describe the issue - [ ] Add a screenshot | Area | Owner | Status | | --- | --- | :---: | | Dashboard | Sam | Review | | Settings | Alex | Done | > Keep the next step easy to find.`; export function MarkdownEditorLiveExample() { const [value, setValue] = useState(initialMarkdown); return (
Markup appears where the caret is and hides elsewhere; the Markdown you type is the Markdown you save.
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `markdown-editor` - `content` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### markdown-editor - `--cui-markdown-editor-background`: `var(--background)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-focus-border-color`: `var(--focus-rim)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-radius`: `var(--radius-panel)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-padding`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 4)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-gutter-size`: `var(--control-h-xs)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-min-height`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 32)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-max-height`: `60dvh` - `--cui-markdown-editor-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 3)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-muted-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-code-background`: `var(--muted)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-table-border-width`: `var(--control-rim-width)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-table-border-color`: `var(--border)` - `--cui-markdown-editor-table-selection-background`: `var(--active-fill)` ### label - `--cui-label-root-foreground`: `var(--foreground)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/kits/markdown-editor?alternative=live - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/markdown-editor.json
